content.subject: Quick thought on your recent acquisition
content.draft_text:
Hi Bruce,
C.H. Robinson announced acquisition of DeSpir Logistics. That adds layers of intercompany matching, manual adjustments, and reporting delays for the CFO, increasing significant workload.
We create a data‑pipeline that consolidates ledger entries, validates them, and reconciles without manual effort.
If you have 15 minutes next week, I can walk through a prototype and answer any remaining questions you may have.
